caption: The drawing depicts a small, rectangular, dark brown wooden box with a brass handle on top and brass hinges on the door. The box is positioned on a flat, light-colored surface. The front of the box is open, revealing its contents and interior structure. Inside, the left section contains two clear glass bottles with stoppers, both tinted faint blue and green, placed upright on a shelf. Below the bottles are two small drawers with round wooden knobs. The right section of the open box door has three additional glass bottles of varying sizes with stoppers, similarly tinted, each positioned in an individual compartment. The wood grain is detailed, showing variations in the brown color, and the brass elements have a subtle yellow-gold tone. The interior compartments are divided by vertical wooden separators matching the exterior color. There is a faintly written signature in the lower right corner of the image. The background is plain, off-white, with no other objects or features present.
title: Portable Medicine Cabinet
